name: Strike-through opens on the problem
looks: On a dark, finely dot-gridded ground, a small wordmark sits above a two-line headline naming the problem; a hand-drawn line strikes through the key problem word, and the line closes on an accent-purple word stating the fix.
build: Headline set in full before the strike so nothing reflows. The struck word gets a single wobbled diagonal stroke drawn on over ~250ms, dropping to 60% opacity once marked. The closing accent word is a different colour from the rest of the headline and holds at full strength.
sound: A single marker-pen scribble exactly as the strike draws on, a soft low swell under the whole card.
prompt: Open on a dark, finely gridded ground with a short two-line headline naming the problem; draw a hand-style strike through the one word that names it, and close the line on an accent-coloured word stating the fix, so the headline reads as problem-then-solution in one breath.
